messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a list of the **long‑weekend holidays** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a three‑day break (Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday or Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday).  (If a holiday falls on a weekend, the observed day is usually the following Monday, which also creates a long weekend.)

| Date | Holiday | Province(s) where it’s a statutory holiday | Notes |
|------|---------|-------------------------------------------|-------|
| **Feb 20, 2023** | Family Day | Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario | Creates a long weekend (Fri 17‑Mon 20) |
| **Apr 7, 2023** | Good Friday | All provinces | Creates a long weekend (Fri 7‑Mon 10) |
| **May 22, 2023** | Victoria Day | All provinces | Creates a long weekend (Fri 20‑Mon 22) |
| **Jul 1, 2023** | Canada Day | All provinces | Observed on Mon 3 (Sat 1‑Mon 3) |
| **Sep 4, 2023** | Labour Day | All provinces | Creates a long weekend (Fri 1‑Mon 4) |
| **Oct 9, 2023** | Thanksgiving | All provinces | Creates a long weekend (Fri 6‑Mon 9) |
| **Nov 11, 2023** | Remembrance Day | All provinces | Creates a long weekend (Fri 8‑Mon 11) |
| **Dec 25, 2023** | Christmas Day | All provinces | Creates a long weekend (Fri 22‑Mon 25) |

### Provincial‑specific long weekends (2023)

| Date | Holiday | Province | Notes |
|------|---------|----------|-------|
| **Mar 17, 2023** | St. Patrick’s Day | Ontario | Creates a long weekend (Fri 17‑Mon 20) |
| **Apr 23, 2023** | St. George’s Day | British Columbia | Creates a long weekend (Fri 23‑Mon 26) |
| **Nov 30, 2023** | St. Andrew’s Day | Nova Scotia | Creates a long weekend (Fri 30‑Mon 3 Dec) |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> - If you want to show *all* long weekends (including provincial ones), merge the tables above.  
> - For a national view, use the first table.  
> - Remember that some holidays (e.g., Canada Day) are observed on a Monday when they fall on a weekend, so the long weekend may span the weekend plus the following Monday.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the list formatted differently or if you need additional details (e.g., exact dates for each province).
